items.headline: Boomer! Oklahoma stuns No. 1 Texas in the Red River Rivalry
items.body: The Sooners stormed back in the second half and beat top-ranked Texas 27-24 at the Cotton Bowl, winning it on a late field goal. Nothing says chaos like the No. 1 team going down in a rivalry game.
items.say: Did you see Oklahoma knock off the No. 1 team? The Red River game is always bonkers.

items.headline: Brewers draw first blood — Milwaukee edges the Dodgers 2-1 in NLCS Game 1
items.body: Brice Turang went deep and the Milwaukee bullpen slammed the door on the star-studded Dodgers lineup, giving the Brewers a 1-0 lead in the National League Championship Series.
items.say: The Brewers just out-pitched the Dodgers in Game 1 — think Milwaukee can actually pull this off?

items.headline: Heartbreak in London — Jaguars stun the Eagles on a field goal as time expires
items.body: Philly led with eight seconds to go, then Cam Little drilled a 57-yarder on the final play to win it 19-17 at Tottenham. It's a third straight loss for the Eagles — and pure water-cooler gold.
items.say: That Jaguars kicker ended the Eagles on the last play in London — brutal way to lose.

items.headline: Vitality sweep MOUZ to win ESL Pro League — ZywOo is MVP again
items.body: In front of a packed Spodek Arena in Katowice, Team Vitality rolled MOUZ 3-0 in the grand final, with superstar ZywOo named tournament MVP. The French squad just keeps stacking trophies.
items.say: Vitality steamrolled the CS2 Pro League final — ZywOo might be the best player on the planet right now.

items.headline: ALCS starts tonight — upstart Guardians visit the Rays with a pennant on the line
items.body: Cleveland, fresh off a wild comeback to reach the ALCS, opens the series tonight in Tampa Bay. First team to four wins books a World Series ticket.
items.say: The ALCS kicks off tonight — I'm pulling for the Guardians after that comeback. You watching?

items.headline: One man, one whale, one hour of air — 'Whalefall' hits theaters Friday
items.body: A diver searching for his late father's remains gets swallowed whole by a 60-ton sperm whale and has 60 minutes of oxygen to get out. Austin Abrams stars alongside Josh Brolin in the survival thriller opening October 16.
items.say: There's a movie about a guy swallowed by a whale with one hour of air to escape — I kind of have to see it.

items.headline: 'Victorious' is back — Netflix's spinoff 'Hollywood Arts' premieres Thursday
items.body: The beloved Nickelodeon musical-comedy gets a reboot: Daniella Monet returns as fan-favorite Trina Vega, now an (unqualified) substitute teacher at the old school, with a whole new class of stars. It lands October 15.
items.say: They made a 'Victorious' spinoff — Trina's back as a substitute teacher. Pure nostalgia.

items.headline: Mr. Worldwide cashes in — Pitbull drops his 14th album 'Pitcoin'
items.body: Dale! Pitbull's new record is out, loaded with party anthems and a guest list that somehow spans KISS, Lil Jon, Enrique Iglesias and Bon Jovi. Exactly as over-the-top as the title suggests.
items.say: Pitbull named his new album 'Pitcoin' and got KISS and Bon Jovi on it — the man is unstoppable.

items.headline: Pet Shop Boys turn Alan Turing's life into an album — 'A Man From The Future'
items.body: The synth-pop legends reworked their 2014 tribute to WWII codebreaker Alan Turing into a full eight-track record, out now. A genuinely fascinating, brainy listen for the history buffs.
items.say: Pet Shop Boys made a whole album about Alan Turing — the codebreaker from 'The Imitation Game.' Wild idea.
